name: manual_a67ff4
claim: On Windows, binding a service to the name localhost listens on the IPv6 loopback only, which an IPv4-loopback upstream such as the portal TLS front end cannot reach. Launch loopback services with an explicit IPv4 loopback host, restart the portal through start.ps1 --restart-portal so its TLS front end restarts with it, and after any restart confirm the listener address, not just the port.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-04: a portal was found listening on IPv6 loopback only with --host localhost; the TLS front end forwards to IPv4 loopback, so the Mac could not reach it. The portal's own restart route launches with the localhost default.

rationale: 2026-11-04: a portal was found listening on IPv6 loopback only with --host localhost; the TLS front end forwards to IPv4 loopback, so the Mac could not reach it. The portal's own restart route launches with the localhost default.
